title: Innate Pharma to participate in the D. Boral Capital Global Conference
body_markdown:
** Thu, 04/23/2026 - 07:00


Innate Pharma SA (Euronext Paris: IPH; Nasdaq: IPHA) (“ **Innate** ” or the “ **Company** ”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing immunotherapies for cancer patients, today announced that members of its executive team will participate in one-on-one investor meetings at the following conference:


**D. Boral Capital Global Conference**


- Date: May 7, 2026
- Location: New York, USA
